svg.title: Medical Knowledge Navigation in MedEvo
svg.desc: Four independent schematic cases illustrate visual misreading, conflicting evidence, missing differential comparison, and a missing diagnostic criterion. Case numbers do not denote training rounds or measured clinical results. A training question supplies observable clinical context. Each fresh failed rollout is diagnosed against four fixed error families, with five subtypes per family. A gold-blind auditor supplies an answer-free recovery cue. The same student keeps supported reasoning and regenerates only the suffix. Screened targets update medical supervision, with at most one active target per question. Each SFT round starts from the same M zero. A separate fixed feedback set supplies assessment signals, never training samples. Feedback shifts selection priorities across the fixed modality, anatomy, disease and difficulty axes. Answer-derived disease labels stay in planning metadata and never reach the auditor or hint. The next training question is diagnosed afresh. CT, histology and ECG contexts and highlighted priorities are illustrative. Select any error-family card to play its complete audit, repair, learning and reselection cycle.
